name: GPU Voxelization
definition: A GPU-based voxelization pipeline using a vertex, geometry, and fragment shader to rasterize triangles into a voxel list. It uses atomic counters to handle concurrent writes.
summary: GPU Voxelization converts triangle meshes into voxel grids by leveraging the GPU rasterization pipeline to write directly to 3D textures, offering high performance over CPU ray-tracing.
